raw_segments.text: If only he had, sighed the old man.
I don't know what had come over the corporal.
The poor wretch must have been sitting there brooding over the loneliness and desolation
And then I suppose it was because those who had come to him were children.
The fact that children had always been afraid of him must have been a source of grief to
And when he saw all those baby faces, with their upturned eyes filled with shining tears,
The children were only waiting for him to rush at them and strike them.
Although they kept right on singing and praying, they were ready to cut and run the instant
Presently a pair of them noticed that Felt's face was beginning to twitch.
Now he'll go for us, they thought, getting up to flee.
But the old man blinked his one good eye, and a tear rolled down his cheek.
And now, as I've already told you, it's all up with Felt.
